title: Ulyana and the Veil
author: Paloma Nystrom
blurb: Ulyana Sterling, the youngest member of a dying guild, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
